Description: Controllers should translate HTTP to service calls and avoid business rules
Don't: Put orchestration and domain logic in controllers

Description: Services should coordinate repositories hooks cache and policies
Don't: Split one business flow across controller and repository

Description: Feature code should stay inside src/modules/<name>
Do: Keep controller service dto repository hooks together
Don't: Import another module internals directly

Guideline: Prefer hooks or events for extension
Description: Cross-module behavior should use hook or event points when possible
Don't: Directly call another module service for side effects
Code Bad: crm service imports unrelated module service

Description: Repositories should own query logic and persistence concerns
Don't: Scatter query builder logic across services

Description: Domain calculations should live close to entities or model helpers
Do: Add domain methods or mappers where useful
Don't: Turn services into giant procedural scripts

Description: HTTP endpoints should be declared through decorators and modules
Don't: Manually wire HTTP handlers outside Nest

Description: Use the repo route conventions for API endpoints
Don't: Mix multiple versioning styles arbitrarily

Description: Public inputs should be validated with DTO classes and pipes
Don't: Trust request bodies directly

Description: List endpoints should normalize page limit filters before querying or caching
Don't: Hash raw unnormalized query objects

Description: All business data access should keep tenant scope explicit
Don't: Read shared business data without tenant filtering

Description: Request tenant resolution should come from the established middleware/context flow
Don't: Parse tenant ad hoc in every controller

Guideline: Render server pages from Nest views
Description: Use view rendering for HTML pages instead of SPA assumptions when applicable
Don't: Assume React hydration or app router patterns

Guideline: Separate page data from page rendering
Description: Prepare page data in services and map it to view models
Don't: Pass raw entities directly into templates

Description: Frontend assets should flow through vite.config.ts into public/assets
Don't: Edit generated files as source of truth

Guideline: Keep generated assets out of design decisions
Description: Treat public/assets as build output
Don't: Review generated CSS as if it were authored source

Description: Tailwind usage should originate from the source CSS entry and actual rendered markup
Don't: Invent separate frontend pipeline without need

Description: Use CacheService for dashboard list and detail reads that are queried often
Don't: Cache directly in controllers or repositories

Description: Cache keys must include tenant scope and resource context
Do: Prefix keys with module and tenant
Don't: Use global keys for tenant data

Description: List and dashboard cache should use a version key instead of wildcard scans
Don't: Scan and delete many wildcard keys on each update

Description: Choose TTL by volatility and endpoint type
Do: Set separate TTL for detail list dashboard
Don't: Use one global TTL for everything
Code Bad: set all keys for 3600 by default

Guideline: Separate HTML cache from data cache
Description: Reverse-proxy cache and Redis cache solve different problems
Don't: Assume Redis replaces HTML caching
Severity: cache data only and ignore page caching

Description: Only public non-user-specific pages should be HTML-cacheable
Don't: Cache personalized pages publicly

Description: Mutations should validate input and apply policy checks before persistence
Don't: Trust body and save directly

Description: Sanitize or escape user-provided HTML before rendering
Don't: Inject raw user HTML into views

Description: Runtime configuration should come from Nest ConfigModule and validated access patterns
Don't: Scatter process.env reads everywhere

Description: Shared headers nav and shells should be centralized for server-rendered pages
Don't: Duplicate shell markup across pages

Description: Templates should not become the place for orchestration or branching business logic
Don't: Compute business state deeply in templates
Code Bad: complex loops + policy logic in template

Description: Form actions should target real Nest routes and return clear success/error flows
Don't: Depend on client-only JS for basic CRUD flow
Code Bad: button onClick fetch only for critical flow

Description: For this repo the minimum safe verification is a successful build
Don't: Claim success from static reading only
Code Bad: Looks correct so it should work

Description: Some areas contain older duplicate files so verify the module wiring before making claims
Don't: Review stale duplicate files and assume they are active

Description: Guides and shared data should describe Workless rather than generic frontend frameworks
Do: Document Nest MVC and cache reality
Don't: Leave copied Next.js or React guidance in place

Description: Optimize as a modular monolith before introducing microservices
Do: Scale with cache queue proxy and module isolation
Don't: Split services prematurely

Guideline: Use reverse proxy for HTML cache
Description: Public cacheable HTML should be designed for NGINX or similar reverse proxy support
Don't: Assume app memory cache is enough for full page caching

Guideline: Use queue for async side effects
Description: Background tasks belong in queue/infrastructure when they do not need synchronous HTTP completion
Don't: Block response on non-critical side effects
Code Bad: send all notifications inline in controller

Guideline: Prefer absolute clarity over borrowed patterns
Description: When stack-specific guidance conflicts with repo reality choose the repo reality
Do: Inspect src and config files first
Don't: Force generic best practices from another stack
